coverage_caveat: Partial summaries are provisional; missing methods may change the best CIL method. Additional NIDS baseline eligibility is recorded separately.
selection_policy: Fixed method per dataset/metric using five-seed mean; classwise envelope for G2 only

G7_measurement_limits.training_seconds_total: Recorded cumulative successful checkpoint training-loop intervals; includes in-loop DER++ memory updates, not total cell walltime.
G7_measurement_limits.evaluation_seconds_total: Sum of saved checkpoint evaluation intervals, including scorer construction and ID/available shift evaluation; not repeated or failed-attempt evaluation cost.
G7_measurement_limits.buffer_selection_seconds_total: Sum of saved post-training selection intervals, including iCaRL herding; DER++ updates memory inside training, so its near-zero selection timer is not zero memory-management cost.
G7_measurement_limits.walltime: Training, evaluation and selection do not exhaust walltime. Data loading, construction, serialization and other overhead, plus failed/cancelled attempts, require separate logs; never add overlapping runner and Slurm durations.
G7_measurement_limits.cuda_memory: Maximum observed PyTorch training-phase allocated/reserved bytes, captured before selection/evaluation; not device-wide usage or a whole-cell peak. Null means unmeasured; missing checkpoint observations can underestimate the peak.
G7_measurement_limits.replay_memory: Maximum saved post-checkpoint payload and allocated replay-storage bytes are distinct; neither includes model/optimizer memory, temporary herding arrays, host RSS or whole-process memory.
G7_measurement_limits.comparability: Stage costs are descriptive for each recorded execution environment; local and HPC timings are not hardware-matched speed comparisons.
